integrity: Analytic probabilistic proof with bounded exact finite cross-checks; no numerical enumeration is used to infer an infinite limit.
scientific_limitations: Fixed dimension, independent and time-stationary-within-coordinate logarithmic cuts with common first and second moments.
Integer-frequency nonresonance is assumed; pathwise strong law, rates, dependent cuts, unequal moments and growing dimension are not proved.
A 2025 preprint already proves all-dimensional Benford marginals for globally iid smooth cuts; new coverage concerns heterogeneous and rough cuts and joint label-phase behavior.
No external or independent mathematical audit performed; novelty remains subject to an independent literature check.
title: Benford limits and asymptotically independent face selection under heterogeneous box fragmentation
